verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://supabase.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 and links to a full-corpus llms-full.txt. The file also points to per-language agent reference corpora, the Management API OpenAPI spec and the MCP endpoint. Agent-oriented docs are further covered by Markdown versions of guide pages, installable Agent Skills, curated AI prompts, and a `search_docs` MCP tool. Missing for 10: the root docs.md returns 404, and there is no independent or community report on how well agents actually use these docs.
